summary: Quiet residential kerb backing onto a grassy reserve, with homes across the road.
reasons: Homes about 16 m across the road

best_section.where: South kerb of Dobell Street beside the grassed reserve, between the two corners

drivers.seclusion: South side backs onto open grass and trees; the nearest homes are about 16 m away across the street.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed street with a wide mown verge; room to pull to the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Only one car seen parked on the street, so a van would be noticed by neighbours.

flags: Low-lying: about 7 m elevation, Cubberla Creek 147 m away
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the reserve cast some shade from the south and west.
